programs.title: Broke
programs.desc: Former rodeo champion True cannot accept the end of his career.He is surprised by a violent blizzard.He fights for survival.

programs.title: Kung Fu Panda 4
programs.desc: Brave Po opens a new chapter in his life - he is to become the spiritual leader of the Valley of Peace.He's trying to get used to his new role.In addition, the voracious bear must find a daredevil who will replace him as the Dragon Warrior.Not everything goes according to plan.This time, China's security is threatened by Chameleon, who wields black magic and can take on any form and take over the abilities of old masters.With the help of a smart vixen and former thief, Zhen, the panda bear must face her.But they need allies to defeat the shape-shifting witch and the sinister army behind her.The time of a merciless fight is inevitably approaching... The voices of the characters include, among others:Marcin Hycnar, Jan Peszek, Wiktor Zborowski and Julia Chatys.

programs.title: Trees, and Other Entanglements
programs.desc: Irene Taylor talks about the extraordinary bond between man and nature, also touching on the topics of mortality and the passage of time.It presents the stories of six people and their deep relationship with trees.

programs.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programs.desc: Four high school students, as part of a punishment imposed by the principal, have to clean up the cluttered school basement.The collected items include an old console from the 1990s and the Jumanji game.Intrigued, the teenagers decide to activate the device.In this way, they are drawn into the virtual world.They end up in a dangerous jungle, where, as avatars, they are forced to fight for survival.Spencer becomes a brave adventurer, Fridge turns into a zoologist, Bethany becomes a corpulent paleontology professor who knows his way around maps, and Martha becomes a martial arts expert.On their way, they meet a guide who tells them the purpose of the mission.

programs.title: Veep 6
programs.desc: Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) briefly enjoyed the presidency.After losing, the ambitious politician must come to terms with the fact that the leader of the free world and president of the United States is this time not her, but Laura Montez (Andrea Savage).After moving out of the White House, Meyer tries to find his way in his new situation.The sixth installment of the HBO comedy series revealing the behind-the-scenes of American politics.The originator of the series is Oscar nominee Armando Iannucci (The Thick of It, Looped), and the main roles include Golden Globe winner Julia Louis-Dreyfus (The Seinfeld Chronicles), Emmy winner Tony Hale (Hot Goods), Anna Chlumsky (My Girl), Reid Scott (My Guys) and Matt Walsh (The Water Breaks).The production has received numerous awards, including:twelve Emmy statuettes, as well as seven Golden Globe nominations.

programs.title: Silver Star
programs.desc: African American Billie (Troy Leigh-Anne Johnson) is twenty years old and a tomboy.He comes from a military family and is missing one eye.After serving her prison sentence, she discovers that her separated parents are facing eviction.He decides to prevent this at all costs.The woman decides to rob a bank, but the action ends in failure.As a result, the young criminal takes her client hostage.Pregnant Franny (Grace Van Dien) is eighteen years old and has a head open to crazy ideas.Together they escape and set off on an adventurous journey.At one point, Franny offers Billie an unexpected deal.

programs.title: Doc Ii.
programs.desc: Dr. Amy Larsen, former chief of internal medicine, is rebuilding her life after a tragic accident that left her with no memory.Now she is an intern.Her past still haunts me.

programs.title: La Casa
programs.desc: After Antonio's death, his three adult children are preparing their holiday home for sale.However, every familiar corner brings back memories.They are increasingly afraid of breaking with the past.

programs.title: Nonostante
programs.desc: A certain man (Valerio Mastandrea) has been in the hospital for a long time, where he leads a quiet life, free from worries and responsibilities.Isolated from the world, he feels safe and considers this place the best for himself.While other patients feel limited, the hospital offers everything he needs.The situation changes when a new patient appears on the ward.She is full of anger, does not agree to the rules of the facility and wants to leave it as soon as possible so that she can truly live.Over time, a man decides to open up to what is foreign to him.Valerio Mastandrea on both sides of the camera.
